female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
female-family-future-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly mention securing the future of their family are associated with increased funding speed.

male-hardship-detail-faster.title: Male borrowers who provide specific details about hardships fund faster.
male-hardship-detail-faster.body: Pitches from men that include concrete examples of current hardships, such as specific lighting sources or lack of infrastructure, are associated with increased funding speed.

female-financial-training-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention receiving financial management training may fund more slowly.

female-loan-amount-faster.body: Female borrowers who request smaller loan amounts may fund faster.

female-age-60-plus-faster.body: Female borrowers aged 60 or older may fund faster.

female-children-count-slower-puzzle.body: Female borrowers who specify the number of children they have may fund more slowly.

female-professional-experience-faster.body: Female borrowers who emphasize management skills and professional experience may fund faster.

female-mention-age-slower.body: Female borrowers who include their age in the pitch may fund more slowly.

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-slower.body: Female borrowers who describe themselves as a hardworking entrepreneur may fund more slowly.

female-geographic-detail-slower.body: Female borrowers who specify their geographic region or province in their pitch may fund more slowly.

female-struggle-narrative-slower.body: Female borrowers who include detailed narratives of family struggle or widowhood may fund more slowly.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who include direct gratitude markers toward lenders may fund more slowly.

female-widow-refugee-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention being a widow or refugee may fund faster.
female-widow-refugee-faster.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap of 10.

female-spouse-mention-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention their husband or spouse may fund more slowly.
female-spouse-mention-slower.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap of 10.

female-gratitude-slower-claim.title: Pitches from women that contain explicit gratitude markers directed at the lenders are associated with slower funding speeds.
female-gratitude-slower-claim.retrospective: Retired to make room for higher-evidence claim regarding family future.

female-college-mention-slower.title: Female borrowers who specifically mention funding children's college education may fund more slowly.
female-college-mention-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that goals related to children's education correlate with faster funding.

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe themselves as a hardworking entrepreneur may fund faster.
female-hardworking-entrepreneur-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that this phrasing correlates with slower funding.

female-nwtf-mention-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the institution NWTF in their pitch may fund faster.
female-nwtf-mention-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning sustaining the business through NWTF loans correlates with slower funding.

female-loan-amount-faster-puzzle.title: Female borrowers who request smaller loan amounts may fund faster.
female-loan-amount-faster-puzzle.retrospective: Dropped as a duplicate of female-loan-amount-faster.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.
monthly-income-slower-general.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap of 8 for higher-evidence promotion.

female-growth-goals-slower.title: Pitches from women that focus on the expansion of their business are associated with slower funding speeds.
female-growth-goals-slower.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap of 8 for promotion of male-hardship-detail-faster.

female-nwtf-mention-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention sustaining their business through NWTF loans may fund more slowly.
female-nwtf-mention-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that NWTF support is associated with faster funding.
